description: This file defines the SkewedClockConfigurator class, which implements the ISiloConfigurator interface to configure a silo host in Orleans testing environment. It sets up a singleton service for IClock with a SkewedClock instance having specified skew bounds.

classes.name: SkewedClockConfigurator
classes.description: A class implementing ISiloConfigurator to set up a skewed clock service in Orleans silo host for testing purposes.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the silo builder by registering a singleton IClock service with a SkewedClock instance having a specified skew range.
